intent: Keep the reviewed interaction in which Run reads Registry-owned facts at preflight pointing at the code that performs it after run creation began handing preflight the facts it read before its transaction.
observable_outcome: An Agent asking how Run and Registry collaborate receives the interaction with a citation that verifies.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The interaction cites the preflight path that refuses without a Registry reader and reads Version facts through it, at the lines it now occupies.
Preflight reads Version facts only through the Registry reader and refuses to answer when no reader was injected.
Run creation reads the package and the provider answers before its transaction and hands them to preflight, so nothing is fetched while the test case is locked.
